answer: Keep each agent's identity as one evolving key chain on a crystal-clear ledger: every epoch, an agent derives its next key from the previous one and publishes the link, so history reads like strata in a canyon wall. One chain head can advance along only one path, so forging a second identity from it is impossible. A newcomer has no chain, so a sable-coated crowd of fresh accounts cannot pose as veterans. Building a credible chain takes real time: an attacker wanting a hundred identities must run a hundred chains for a hundred epochs, while idle chains fade and rented histories decay.
